# Selected original dsh-context dashboard

Public source: [bowenliang123/dsh-context](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context/tree/2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499), version **0.68.1**, commit **2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499**. Original **Copyright 2025 bowenliang123** and [Apache 2.0](LICENSE) apply to the selected supplier files. The inspected commit has no separate NOTICE file. They are not MIT and Augmentor’s resale restriction does not replace their licence.

SOURCE.json records every selected file’s original/adapted SHA-256. Eighty-six files are selected; three presentation modules carry prominent change notices: disable automatic registry checks and an unbound DSH settings shortcut, remove an unattested DSH compaction threshold, and mark unobserved skill/fleet data unavailable. Cards, charts, browser, interactions and CSS retain the supplier structure. Unused selected modules never enter the browser graph.

Build-time module resolution binds historyPage and modelPrices to independently authored read-only Pi glue. Inline projections supply retained Pi observations; there is no supplier plugin Host, Cordis runtime, extra agent/session loop, external price/registry fetch or DSH history route in the browser graph. Tailwind 4.3.3 generates the supplier utility CSS using the original source and pinned build-only compiler; its MIT notice is included separately in the bundled notices.

See [qualification and coverage](../../../../docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md#original-context-dashboard--october-11-follow-up). The Context tab is qualified first. Cross-session Context Insights, Fleet, right-sidebar placement, slash modal and persistent plugin preferences are not claimed as ported.
